summary: CervoMed Inc. (Nasdaq: CRVO), a clinical-stage biotech, filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026 furnishing a press release under Items 7.01 and 8.01 announcing pharmacokinetic, regulatory and manufacturing updates for neflamapimod. A new 50 mg tablet formulation improves PK, and the FDA removed the prior drug exposure limit, providing dosing flexibility. The company plans to advance a 100 mg twice-daily regimen targeting higher plasma trough concentrations than those tied to clinical activity in prior trials. No transaction terms, board recommendation or advisor are disclosed; no special-situation mechanic such as a deal clock, stake or overhang applies. Watch clinical execution and any follow-on financing risk.
